links.outcome: Volume of voluntary user feedback after pilot versus hospital-wide routine use
links.effect: Feedback volume decreased compared with the pilot as routine use grew (1,028 users, 14,910 conversations over five months), indicating voluntary reporting declines and automated monitoring is needed.
links.quote: Feedback volume decreased compared with the pilot, suggesting that routine use diminishes voluntary reporting and underscoring the need for complementary automated monitoring strategies.

unlisted_practices: On-premises, GDPR-compliant LLM hosting to keep patient data within the hospital
Embedding an LLM assistant directly in the EHR workflow to sustain use
Tracking usage patterns (task types, daily and weekly use) as an adoption metric

screen.reason: This is a real-world deployment study of an on-premises RAG-based LLM integrated into Epic EHR at a European hospital, describing usage patterns, feasibility, and adoption across over a thousand clinicians without testing a specific safeguard comparative intervention.
